scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @pce/contracts && npm run dev -w @pce/api
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format:check: prettier --write apps/mobile/App.tsx apps/web/src/App.tsx packages/api-client/src/index.ts packages/api-client/src/index.test.ts && node -e "const fs=require(\"node:fs\");for(const p of [\"apps/mobile/App.tsx\",\"apps/web/src/App.tsx\",\"packages/api-client/src/index.ts\",\"packages/api-client/src/index.test.ts\"]){console.log(\"PCE_FORMAT_BEGIN:\"+p);console.log(fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\"));console.log(\"PCE_FORMAT_END:\"+p);}" && prettier --check "{apps,packages}/**/*.{ts,tsx,json}" "*.{json,mjs}"
scripts.typecheck: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @pce/core && npm run build -w @pce/contracts && npm run build -w @pce/api-client && npm run build -w @pce/db && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
